## What changed

One or two sentences, and how you checked it.

## Open items

Closed: the `docs/state.md` items this settles. Opened: what is now unverified, each with `closed when:`. Or "none".

## Fixed at the component

For a UI fix: the component, class or token that changed. If a page was patched instead, why the component could not hold it. Or "no UI change".

## Batching

The open PR this could have joined, and why it did not (a design-system change joins the rolling `design-system` PR). Or "none".

## Shared files

Any shared stylesheet or component in `git diff --stat origin/main`, and why. Otherwise "none".

## Review

The tier (0, 1 or 2) and the file that sets it; the `cr review` pass, or why it did not run; CodeRabbit's last reviewed commit, or why none (`docs/engineering/code-review.md`).
